key_idea: Try every divisor k of the length in increasing order and check directly that each block is the previous one rotated right by one.
sketch: For each k dividing n, verify s[b+j] == s[b-k+(j-1 mod k)] for every block start b>=k and offset j. First k that passes is the answer; k=n always works. O(n * d(n)) with n<=100. Pitfall: rotation direction (last character moves to the front).
